Results.ReviewText:
I have been mostly happy with my purchase of the E-210. One of the reason o bought a Weber, was because I had been told how well that all levels of the grills cooked evenly - front to back and side to side; I am not finding this to be true with my grill. At first I thought it was because I would open the lid too much, so I changed how much I was opening the lid. Then I thought it was because of one of the cooks I used cheaper burgers and the grill became very dirty, so o cleaned every inch with a deep clean - no change. I have been extremely picky about the cleaning of the grill since day one anyway. Just thought I would be in awe of the grill and am finding it to be just the same as the last one I bought at half the price and half the cost - with cooking evenly. 

I have also been surprised that the flame on the back tube becomes yellow after warming up - I have had many cheaper grills and that did not happen with those until years into their life. Maybe that is normal, I just was surprised. 

I have been mostly happy with my Father’s Day/ Birthday present and I am proud to own a Weber. There are many things that I really do like about the grill and I am sure I will have many years of good cooking. 

Thank you.
Results.Title: Surprised with even grilling

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the most amazing grill! For years we have purchased the other brands - thinking why would you spend that much on a grill - but it is so worth it! Results.Title: Best grill ever!

Results.ReviewText: We are empty nesters and gave our prior Weber grill (Spirit III) to our daughter since we no longer had a need for such a large grill and downsized to the Spirit II. She uses the Spirit III daily and raves about it, even though it is over 15 years old.  The Spirit II is NOTHING like our prior Weber grill. It is made of much thinner materials and seems very flimsy when compared to our prior Spirit III.  The drip pan area is a nightmare! It catches fire with alarming ease, even when it is cleaned thoroughly after each use.  After being a diehard Weber fans for over 15 years we are actively searching for a safe replacement. We sadly cannot recommend Weber to anyone as a safe, quality product.
Results.Title: Fire

44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
